events.title: Delaware hit by rare November tornado
events.description: Meanwhile, severe thunderstorms bring hailstones the size of baseballs in Argentina The National Weather Service in the US has confirmed that an EF1 tornado touched down south-east of Newark in the Salem Woods neighbourhood, Delaware, on Thursday. The tornado reached 160 metres wide, had a path length of 4.4 miles (7.1km) and reached estimated peak winds of up to 100mph (161km/h). There were no injuries or fatalities but windows and roofs were damaged on several homes, a large hotel sign fell on to a number of cars, and a semi truck overturned on I95. Although Delaware often experiences a few tornadoes every year, this is only the second time the state has had tornado activity in November since 1950, according to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. The only other November tornado recorded was in 1989. Severe storms have also resulted in tornadoes in Argentina as well as large hailstones. A round of severe thunderstorms moved through the central Córdoba province on Friday, bringing hailstones up to the size of a baseball (about 7.5cm in diameter). Parts of the province recorded up to 73mm of rainfall in just six hours early on Saturday. Such storms are common at this time of year. Water vapour from the Amazon meeting the Andes quickly condenses, resulting in massive cloud formations often associated with heavy downpours, lightning, tornadoes and large hailstones. Continue reading...
events.ticker_label: 🌪️ Delaware hit by rare November tornado

events.title: Storm Charles causes floods and flight cancellations across southern Europe
events.description: Heavy rain and strong winds have also caused disruption across British Columbia, Canada, over the last week Storm Charles has brought destructive weather to the Iberian peninsula this week, particularly in Portugal and the far south of Spain. Heavy rain and strong south-westerly winds arrived first in the Portuguese island of Madeira, before the system headed towards the mainland on 11 November. A wind gust of 84.5mph (136 km/h) was recorded at Funchal airport, alongside rainfall totals reaching 355mm (13.97in) in 12 hours. In Lisbon, 183 flights were cancelled on Wednesday, about a third of its normal daily traffic, while Madrid Barajas airport had 155 cancellations. After causing widespread flooding in Spain and Portugal, the system moved on a north-easterly track through southern France and then towards northern Italy. This resulted in significant flooding in parts of Cannes, some of which caused rock falls and led to the closure of roads along the French Riviera. The Italian weather service issued a red rainfall warning, its highest level, for the area extending from Tuscany to Venezia. Further heavy rain is expected to fall in Italy and the Balkans over the next few days, with the latest forecast models indicating an additional 100mm could accumulate widely, while totals close to 200mm are likely in more mountainous areas. events.title: British actor Robert Pattinson confirmed as new James Bond
events.description: James Bond 007 ranks among the longest-running and highest-grossing movie franchises in Hollywood's ​history.

events.title: Pope concludes South America homecoming, reassures faithful after cancer scare
events.description: Pope Leo XIV finished Monday his 12-day tour of Uruguay, Argentina and Peru reiterating his advocacy for social justice, environmental protection and the importance of community. Just a month after undergoing lung cancer surgery, the 71-year-old pontiff drew millions of faithful across South America, where he spent nearly two decades as a missionary.

events.title: Three Melbourne Cup trophies worth £500k each stolen
events.description: Police are searching for three Melbourne Cup trophies collectively worth more than £1.5m after they were stolen from a display cabinet at a racecourse in Melbourne.

events.description: The US government is set to further restrict China's access to the most powerful AI chips, such as the ones provided by tech giant Nvidia.

events.description: Lindsay Clancy is due to face a retrial next March over the killing of her three young children.

events.title: When the rains fail: Preparing for drought in Central America
events.description: Across Central America’s so-called Dry Corridor, farming families live at the mercy of the rains. In southwestern Honduras, Anastacio Martínez Gómez has spent most of his 73 years learning to work the land. But experience can only take him so far.

events.title: ‘Here, you can eat until you’re full’: Oleshky evacuees savour first proper meals in years
events.description: In a quiet hospital corridor in Kyiv, staff and volunteers push carts carrying steaming pots of chicken soup, bread and buckwheat porridge to patients recently evacuated from Russian-occupied Oleshky, in Ukraine’s southern Kherson region.

events.title: ‘Lives are at stake’: Humanitarians call for swift entry of winter supplies in Gaza
events.description: Winter supplies must enter the Gaza Strip where “lives are at stake”, the UN and partners said in an urgent appeal on Friday, in the wake of deadly rainfall this past weekend.

events.title: America hits a tech wall as outages cripple email, ground flights and disrupt major banks
events.description: A wave of tech failures hit Chase, Bank of America and Wells Fargo online banking Monday, days after a Microsoft 365 outage and FAA ground stop.

events.title: Trump border crackdown drives encounters to record October low as zero-release streak hits 18 months, DHS says
events.description: Border Patrol recorded just 8,288 southwest border apprehensions in October, marking a stunning 95% drop from the Biden administration's average.

events.title: American basketball player’s Nigeria trip ends in arrest after officials spot him abandoning suspicious bags
events.description: Nigerian officials say an American basketball player abandoned two checked bags containing 75 pounds of cannabis before officers arrested him in a parking lot.

events.title: Pope Leo XIV hit in the face by flying rosary during farewell Mass in Peru, video shows
events.description: Pope Leo XIV was struck near the eye by a rosary tossed at his popemobile in Lima, Peru, video shows, but the pontiff continued the farewell Mass.

events.title: Mexico's cartel 'godfather' convicted in American DEA agent's murder dies at age 80
events.description: The Guadalajara cartel boss convicted in DEA agent Enrique "Kiki" Camarena's murder died at 80, decades after the killing triggered Operation Leyenda.
